stops.title: The pipeline
stops.caption: Four sessions, then a department.
stops.speech: New Believers is the discipleship track. Four sessions, then integration into a department, with each person visible on the board.

stops.title: Sessions
stops.caption: Scheduled, taught and registered.
stops.speech: Sessions are scheduled per branch with a teacher and a date. Take the register in the session, then advance people to the next stage.
